tool_args.rationale: The observed gradient dependence and concavity support a siphon family, but several archived mechanisms can plausibly fit five observations. The open-branch probe directly tests that ambiguity before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with a square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot observations leave the branch form and competing sink-coupled mechanisms insufficiently distinguished.
The pilot signatures favor a static sink-coupled mechanism; an expensive trajectory batch is not yet warranted.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
